title: Texas Strategic Bitcoin Reserve
summary: Creates the Texas Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, a state fund outside the treasury that the comptroller can use to invest in bitcoin.
verified: 2026-10-21, Texas Legislature Online and LegiScan roll calls

context.Trenton E. Ashby: The Texas Bitcoin PAC gave Ashby $500 on Dec. 5, 2022 and $1,000 on Dec. 13, 2024.

title: East Texas groundwater study and export pause
summary: Would have required the Texas Water Development Board to study the aquifers under the Neches and Trinity Valleys Groundwater Conservation District, with a pause on new export permits while the study ran. The Senate removed the pause, the House rejected that change, and the bill died.
verified: 2026-10-21, Texas Legislature Online, Senate floor report, Texas Tribune

labels.FA1 Nichols: his own amendment removing the export pause

context.Trenton E. Ashby: Joint author of the House bill with the export pause.
context.Robert Lee Nichols: Carried the bill in the Senate, then offered the amendment that removed the export pause. He told senators it was the only way to get the study through.
